## What it computes

$c$ rounded to a number of `T`:

$$z = \mathrm{RN}(c).$$

## C++

**Not yet called by the public headers.** No public operation computes this kernel yet.

## Requires

- Every limb of every operand is a finite number of `T`.

## Target (not proved)

When the requirements hold and no operation of the kernel overflows:

- $z = \mathrm{RN}(c)$: the number of the format nearest to $c$, ties to even.

Stated for every binary format with a precision of at least 1 bit, rounding to nearest with ties to even and with gradual underflow, in the model where no operation overflows. Both limb types qualify: `double` has 53 bits, `float` has 24 bits.

## Status

**UNVERIFIED.** No proof of the statement is checked.

The statement, as Rocq reads it (the vocabulary, `fmt`, `RN`, `u`, `eta` and `normalized_2`, is defined at the top of the same file; `emin` is the exponent of $\eta$ and `prec` the precision):

```coq
Definition bv_center_entry_1_spec : Prop :=
  forall emin prec : Z, (1 <= prec)%Z ->
  forall c : R,
  fmt emin prec c ->
  let z := bv_center_entry_1 emin prec tie_even c in
  fmt emin prec z /\
  z = RN emin prec c.
```

## Source

**Algorithm:** the guard of a constructor (milestone2.md, BallVector, Values). **License:** algorithm and proof: MIT.

## Listing

From [`gen/kernels/bv_center_entry_1.kernel`](https://github.com/danielepanozzo/kairn/blob/main/gen/kernels/bv_center_entry_1.kernel), the description the C++ and the formal models (`proofs/gen/Model.v`, `proofs/gen/IeeeModel.v`) are generated from. Each line is one operation of `T`; one that rounds rounds to nearest, and `prod(a, b)` is $\mathrm{RN}(ab)$, written as a fused multiply-add with a zero addend ([the kernel IR](../developer/architecture.md#the-kernel-ir)).

```
# The step of bv_make_1, the constructor of a BallVector with one-limb centers (milestone2.md,
# "BallVector", "Values"): a center that the program gives, guarded (rule R3) as the constructors of a
# Ball are. Its value is the center itself: guard(c) is RN(c + 0), which is c (a zero made +0), and an
# infinity or a NaN stays what it is, which the finish of the constructor tests.

z = guard(c)
```
